title: Quebec City Photo Tour
includes: Pick up and drop off at the hotel (not included)
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for people with mobility problems
Not recommended for people with problems on stairs
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Quebec City Photo Tour offers a 2 hour tour in the tourist part of the city. You will be accompanied by a professional photographer who will advise you on your photography skills. The goal is to help you improve in order to make you a better photographer. All that while discovering the beautiful places of Quebec City.
